source: Orion Connect position snapshots (silver api_dims positions_mv, daily account value) and Orion transactions (silver, full-history snapshot 2026-10-08), custodian Fidelity, read through the registry's routed legacy bucket alias
comparison_source: Orion Connect query API (read-only), saved query 'Performance Dim' with the performance option's feeMethod overridden to Gross Of Fees: account-level TWR, Before-Tax, Gross of Fees, Annualized, window Rolling 3-Year (2023-10-09 .. 2026-10-08)
grain: account-windows (one reported return per account over the source's own window)
comparison: our total_return_daily (gross of the advisory fee, flows by the ratified taxonomy) compounded over the source's window, annualised by trading days / 252, against Orion's gross twr value, absolute gap in percentage points of the annual rate

class_definitions.LINK_BROKEN_NO_BASE: The geometric link breaks inside the window: at least one trading day has no return because the prior-day value is absent or not positive (a closed, emptied or not yet funded account), so nothing compounds across it.
class_definitions.DEPARTURE_FLOW_CLASS: Misses on the ratified flow set and lands within tolerance of Orion's gross figure once the two departing classes (Internal Account Journal pair, Federal/State Tax Withheld) are treated as flows.
class_definitions.OTHER_FEE_ADDBACK: Misses on the ratified flow set and lands within tolerance once the Return-bucket trading and administrative fees (Trading Expense, ADR Fee, Administrative Fee and Adjustment, Wire Fee) are added back as well; the departing classes alone do not reach it.
class_definitions.DEPARTURE_AND_OTHER_FEE: Misses on the ratified set, and reaches tolerance only with both the departing classes and the other fees applied.
class_definitions.RESIDUAL_LARGE_FLOW: No flow or fee variant reaches tolerance, and the window holds a single day whose flow is at least 10 percent of the prior value (timing of a large flow against the vendor's valuation).
class_definitions.RESIDUAL_NO_LARGE_FLOW: No flow or fee variant reaches tolerance and no day carries a large flow: the gap is not explained by anything this adapter reads; its size is the evidence.

flagged_classes.treatment: read and counted; NOT a flow in the headline (ratified taxonomy)
flagged_classes.departure: DEPARTURE FROM THE RATIFIED TAXONOMY (filed Internal). Read, counted and flagged; NOT a flow in the headline figure. Round 36 measured it as a flow at the account grain; the amendment proposal is row W49-S3 / DB-b-77.

flagged_classes.treatment: read and counted; NOT a flow in the headline (ratified taxonomy)
flagged_classes.departure: DEPARTURE FROM THE RATIFIED TAXONOMY (filed Return, inside the return). Read, counted and flagged; NOT a flow in the headline figure.

fee_source: Orion Connect query API, saved query 'Unified Account Dim': Activity.Value with activityOptionId 11 (Advisory Fees Paid), per account over the Rolling 3-Year window (PATH_DISCOVERY.md:181); billed / unbilled from Asset.IncludedInBilling of saved query 'Billing Dim' (PATH_DISCOVERY.md:158); supervised / unsupervised from the account-level managed flag landed in silver/api_dims/accounts_v2 (inferred)

fee_detail.unit: US dollars of advisory fees paid over the window, absolute value (Orion stores a fee as negative)
fee_detail.billed_plus_unbilled_unreadable_note: billed and unbilled are sums over the accounts whose flag Orion could read; the accounts with the flag broken are in included_in_billing_flag_broken_fees, so billed + unbilled + broken = billing_total

by_bill_presence.meaning: an alternative billed / unbilled cut that does not depend on the broken flag: an account has a Billing.FeeAmount or it has none

fee_detail.billing_fee_amount_meaning: Billing.FeeAmount: the amount of the account's last bill cycle, a different quantity from fees paid over the window; printed beside, not substituted
fee_detail.ledger_cross_check: silver/transactions Management Fee plus Fee Credit rows (status Complete) for the same accounts and window, absolute net sum, against supervision_total

net_control.meaning: the live read (taken after the landed snapshot) of the SAME net-of-fee figure against the landed one

unlike_for_like_pairing.meaning: Opal's NET compounding (fee left inside the return) against Orion's GROSS figure: the unlike-for-like pairing, printed so the gap the gross basis closes is visible
